_comment: EP48.5 O1 - Cloudflare Access applications for core.pdabliss.com. PREPARED ONLY: created at O5 after owner approval (OD-P2, OD-P7).
A1 (admin paths) stays until EP48.6. A2 (whole hostname) exists only in restricted mode R; removing A2 at O7 = public login.
Policies name people (e-mail addresses filled in at O5 from the owner's list); never 'Everyone', a whole e-mail domain or a bypass rule.
Created BEFORE the public hostname (O5), so the hostname never exists without them.
